scope: 20 fixed random cases drawn before web investigation from 208 eligible San Diego conservative persistent-absence listing IDs
protocol: Search baseline listing title and/or exact permit; check current municipal registry; search exact registry address when available; follow relevant leads to property or platform pages. Record event dates independently of access dates. Never interpret no search result as a negative property-use observation.
limitations: Public-web pilot, not an exhaustive deed/MLS or cross-platform census. Search indexes and pages can be stale. No current booking availability was verified. Historical presence on other platforms was not exhaustively measured, so no competitive migration is confirmed. Property sale and property use are separate axes. Case URLs are provenance; raw addresses, contact details and listing records remain in ignored storage.
